art_direction: 拉丝黄铜构成单个开放结，弧线粗细均衡，深灰底上暖反射清楚。
composition: one original focal subject, centered and readable within a circular avatar crop
creative_direction: Create a small abstract open knot made from one continuous brushed-brass rod. Use a broad oval bend and a shorter crossing loop, leaving enough space to see through the structure. The rod should have gentle irregularity in thickness, not a perfect mathematical torus. Place it on a dark charcoal surface with a matching backdrop. Use soft side lighting to reveal brushed metal grain and warm reflections without harsh hotspots. Keep the silhouette compact, with no chain, jewelry fittings, or ornamental engraving. Create a square 1024x1024 avatar with a clear central silhouette that remains legible at thumbnail size. Use an original text-only composition, without lettering, logos, signatures, or watermarks.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for clear original focal composition, requested medium and detail level, circular-crop readability, no unintended anatomy or rendering defects, no text or watermark
